findings.title: TF_Settings_ButcherHint uses a body size that no bear has (2.4; Core bears are 2.15)
findings.detail: The hint says "A steel bear (body size 2.4)" and TitanSettings.cs:95 computes the figure with 2.4f. Bear_Grizzly and Bear_Polar both get baseBodySize 2.15 from BaseBear, so at the default 40 per body size the hint promises ~96 steel and the player gets ~86. Change the text to "(body size 2.15)" here and the 2.4f to 2.15f on TitanSettings.cs:95, together.

evidence.ref: Defs/Core/ThingDefs_Races/Races_Animal_Bears.xml (BaseBear <baseBodySize>2.15</baseBodySize>; Bear_Grizzly and Bear_Polar do not override it)

findings.title: Default light-follow distance went from 2 cells to 1, so glowing walkers rebuild lighting every cell
findings.detail: TitanGlower.FollowCells was 2 and the removed doc comment called the lighting-mesh rebuild 'the real cost'. The new setting defaults to 1, and Update skips the throttle when follow <= 1, so at default settings every moving glowing titan deregisters and re-registers its light on every cell. If the old behaviour is wanted at default, set the default to 2 in the field, Reset() and the Scribe default (TitanSettings.cs lines 12, 31, 48).

findings.title: Right settings column is close to its 544px height with no scroll view
findings.detail: Dialog_ModSettings gives the mod 864x584 (900x700 window minus 18px margins, 40px title and 40px CloseButSize), so each column is about 420x544. My estimate for the right column (section header, five sliders with mostly two-line Tiny hints, checkbox and hint) is about 530px. It fits in English, but Listing_Standard.Begin clips to the column, so longer translated hints would cut off the market-value hint. The height estimate is mine, not measured.

findings.title: Public static tunables removed from a framework's API
findings.detail: TitanMaterialUtility.ArmorFactor, TitanMaterialUtility.ButcherYieldPerBodySize and TitanGlower.FollowCells were public static fields and are gone. Nothing installed or in the indexed corpus references them, but a separately compiled dependent mod that set them would throw MissingFieldException. Worth a changelog line, or obsolete forwarding properties if downstream mods exist.

findings.title: Settings text fits the default window with little room to spare and no scroll view
findings.detail: Dialog_ModSettings is 900x700, leaving ~544 px per column after TitanSettings subtracts 40. By estimate the right column needs ~520 px in English, with hints wrapping to two lines at Tiny font in a ~420 px column. A translation with longer hints would overflow the bottom (Market value row). This is an estimate from the code, not a measured layout.
